english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being busy, including a busy place or period.
Use 忙 as the all-purpose choice when someone is occupied or unavailable.

examples.english: I'm engaged with work right now, so I can't reply to you yet.
examples.traditional: 我而家好忙，未得閒覆你。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hou2 mong4 mei6 dak1 haan4 fuk1 nei5
